name: Gorgias
one_liner: Gorgias is an e-commerce customer support desk that provides a REST API to manage support users, tickets, and integrations.
access_note: Private apps do not require approval and can be built directly using REST API credentials, whereas public apps require joining the Developer Portal and app review.

evidence.quote: In order to be able to have an approved public app with Gorgias, it is required that the app is using OAuth2 for authentication.
For Private apps there is no need for approval. Go ahead and use it!
Gorgias has an open REST API - go to Settings → You → REST API to access your unique credentials.
